overview.text: Today's key developments span open-source tooling, agent applications, model releases, and research. Huawei has released MACaQ as its internal quantizer for local inference across text, image, video, and audio models. In real-world agent deployments, developers are seeing new capabilities and pushback, as AI agents successfully discovered an unmapped Maya site while United Airlines formally banned AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers. Meanwhile, model releases continue to advance rapidly, highlighted by Tencent introducing a new speculative decoding method via tencent/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpine-b16, and deepseek-ai launching deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. In research, new diagnostic frameworks like PhyRubric evaluate physical commonsense in text-to-video generation, and work on Tree-Ising explores repairing language models with bit-level Ising edits.

entries.title: Huawei releases MACaQ, its internal quantizer for local inference
entries.summary: SOTA model-agnostic quantization for GGUF, local inference and beyond. Quantize and run text, image, video and audio models with llama.cpp, vLLM, Diffusers and PyTorch. · C++
entries.why: Huawei's MACaQ offers model-agnostic quantization for local inference across diverse modalities like text and video.

entries.title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
entries.summary: As text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly positioned as world simulators, it is essential to evaluate whether their videos conform to physical commonsense.
entries.why: PhyRubric provides rubric-grounded diagnostic evaluation of physical commonsense in text-to-video generation models.

entries.title: Test-Time Scaling for Diffusion Language Models with Frequency-Aware Remasking
entries.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, where decisions about which tokens to commit or remask strongly affect output quality.
entries.why: Test-time scaling for diffusion language models with frequency-aware remasking addresses iterative denoising decisions.

entries.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
entries.summary: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair.
entries.why: Tree-Ising enables frontier LLM agents to read network weights and write repairs using bit-level Ising edits.
